Episode 11 - From Ladd to Leaders - A Conversation with Joanne Malise, Judy Niedbala, and David Reiss

Disability News You Can Use
May 30 2025 • 45 mins
Join us as we have a candid conversation with Joanne Malise, Director of Living Innovations , Judy Niedbala, the recently retired Chief Executive Officer of Perspectives Corporation , and David Reiss, the Chief Executive Officer of The Fogarty Center . We discuss their days at the Ladd School, the impact they have had on the Developmental Disability (DD) system since then, how to build a good life, and their thoughts for the future.
Enjoy!
